macro_f1: Unweighted F1 across all fourteen named actions, including zero for absent rare classes; unknown reserved label excluded.
history: Utility-event unset coordinates are zeroed before model encoding; no current/future event in history.
baseline_probability: Heuristic point prediction gets fixed .9 mass and .1 train-frequency mixture. Action/offset counts use fixed positive pseudocounts.
destination_error: Report decoded-label error plus mean over all movement rows with 16-cell penalty for undecodable predictions.
no_claim: A partially observed joint likelihood is not a full original-command likelihood; full engine illegal-action rate is not certified.
